title: C++: Common Idioms
description: Demonstrate common C++ idioms: RAII wrapper and copy-and-swap.

steps.title: RAII with Copy-and-Swap
steps.description: Create a `DynArray` class that manages a dynamic int array. Implement the Rule of Five using copy-and-swap: destructor, copy constructor, move constructor, copy assignment (via swap), move assignment.
hints: void swap(DynArray& other) noexcept { std::swap(data, other.data); std::swap(size, other.size); }
Move constructor: DynArray(DynArray&& other) noexcept : data(other.data), size(other.size) { other.data = nullptr; other.size = 0; }

verification.failureMessage: Demonstrate construction, copy, move, and assignment
